title: UI Kit token-scale audit & mobile breakpoint regression triage
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: perform a focused audit of token scaling (type, spacing, elevation) and components (buttons, tables, charts) to identify cross-browser (Safari, Firefox) and mobile breakpoint regressions introduced during recent token cleanup. Outcome: a prioritized triage list with reproducible steps, design fixes, and staging PRs linked for engineering.
steps_to_reproduce: Open Figma spec: https://figma.com/file/placeholder/ui-kit-v2-tokens (see Token Scale page)
Load component examples in latest Safari (macOS Ventura) and Firefox (macOS/Windows) using viewport presets: 375x812, 768x1024, 1366x768
Compare rendered pages against design snapshots in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/UI+Kit+Snapshots
For charts: load sample dashboard (staging) and toggle time ranges; observe axis clipping and legend overlap on Firefox
For tables: test responsive collapse, header sticky behavior, and row density at <600px on Safari and Chrome mobile view
For buttons: inspect compact vs default tokens; confirm focus ring and hit area match token values across browsers
proposed_fixes: Reintroduce a small set of legacy spacing tokens (s-legacy-* ) for components that rely on non-linear scale — limit to buttons and table cells
Patch chart CSS to use transform-based axis positioning instead of top/left offsets to avoid subpixel rounding in Firefox
Add platform-specific overlay rules for Safari overflow: -webkit-overflow-scrolling adjustments and explicit backface-visibility for sticky headers
Adjust button hit area via padding tokens, not margin collapse; add visual regression test for focus state
Create a small util (token-normalizer) to map deprecated tokens to new scale at runtime for Dedicated customers until code-rollout completes

Chart axis clipping is resolved in Firefox across breakpoints with visual regression snapshots passing
Table sticky headers behave consistently in Safari and Chrome mobile emulation without layout jank
Button focus and hit-area match updated tokens; accessibility audit (keyboard + screen reader) passes
Token-normalizer utility provided as temporary toggle and documented; final migration plan exists (owner: ENG-2145)
